## What's new in Igggy 0.1.21
- **Long meetings finish saving.** With Keep audio recordings on, a meeting longer than about 47 minutes could stay on "Saving note" for good, and every note after it waited behind it. The note now finishes first, and the audio copy saves on its own afterward. - **You'll know when the backup wrote your note.** If Claude or OpenAI can't write a note (no credit, a key that stopped working, their servers busy), Apple's model still writes it, and the note now says so at the top, in plain words, with a button to rewrite it with your model once it works again. When the problem needs you, like adding credit, Today and Settings say so until it's fixed. - **See which model wrote each note.** It's on the line with the people in the meeting: "Written by Claude Sonnet 5.5". - **Notes name the other person.** On a call with one other person, the note says their name instead of "Others", taken from the invite or the meeting's title. - **Names spelled right.** When the transcript mishears the name of someone on the invite ("Catherine" for Kathryn), Igggy corrects it before writing the note. - **Confirm speaker names, then rewrite.** After a meeting, confirm who each voice is and rewrite the note with their names. Afterward, Show what changed points out each new name, each new owner and each new task or decision. - **Your side and theirs, on speaker calls.** When a call plays through your Mac's speakers, the live page now keeps the other person's words on their side instead of mixing them into yours. - **Calls on your own calendar count down too.** A call you put on your calendar without inviting anyone now counts down in the menu bar, and Today offers Record call for it. - **Voice ID on the person card.** Click someone's circle to see whether Igggy recognizes their voice, and remove it if you want. - **Polish.** The note's date line no longer cuts off, and View in Calendar has its ↗.
